local self=require('openmw.self')
local types=require('openmw.types')
local core=require('openmw.core')
local nearby=require('openmw.nearby')
local Actor=require('openmw.types').Actor
local frames=0
return {{engineHandlers={{onFrame=function()
 frames=frames+1;if frames<60 or frames%15~=0 then return end
 for _,obj in ipairs(Actor.inventory(self):getAll()) do if obj.recordId==core.getFormId('Oblivion.esm',0x000c4f) then local rec=types.Apparatus.record(obj);assert(rec.type==3 and rec.quality==10 and rec.weight==3 and rec.value==50,'Original Retort properties changed');print('RetortDrop original properties type=3 quality=10 weight=3 value=50') end end
 assert(not Actor.isDead(self),'Player died testing genuine Retort drop')
 print('RetortDrop stock='..Actor.inventory(self):countOf(core.getFormId('Oblivion.esm',0x000c4f))..' health='..Actor.stats.dynamic.health(self).current..' nirnroot='..Actor.inventory(self):countOf(core.getFormId('Oblivion.esm',0x4e940))..' paused='..tostring(core.isWorldPaused()))
 for _,o in ipairs(nearby.items) do
  if tostring(o.recordId)==tostring(core.getFormId('Oblivion.esm',0x000c4f)) then assert(not types.Apparatus.objectIsInstance(o),'Retort world drop must have native identity');print('RetortDrop nearby id='..o.id..' base='..tostring(o.recordId)..' position='..tostring(o.position)) end
 end
end}}}}
